name: anomaly detection routes
description: The stock Anomaly Detection plugin's detector, validate, preview, start, stop, profile, search, stats and results routes: single entity, high cardinality and historical analysis. Generated ids are placeholders.
setup: index compat-ad-src: 120 documents one a minute from epoch ms 1700000000000, v a sine around 10 with a spike of 20 at minutes 90 and 91, keyword host (2 values) and city (3 values)
placeholders: `{label}` in a request is the value the step that captured it received; `<label>` in a response is where that value appeared. `<volatile>` is a time, a counter or a generated value that differs on every run.
